capabilities.target: HOME or USERPROFILE, plus APPDATA and SystemRoot on Windows
capabilities.justification: Resolves the default configuration, credential, service, and native Task Scheduler paths.

capabilities.target: default config, credential, sibling daemon, supervisor, and service-definition paths
capabilities.justification: Loads strict local connection authority and validates every native installer input.

capabilities.target: configured credential and current-user native service paths
capabilities.justification: Composes atomic credential creation and native service-definition publication.

capabilities.target: configured credential and current-user native service definition
capabilities.justification: Persists owner-only local authority and the synchronized native daemon definition.

capabilities.target: configured [vault] kek_path and the vault storage root
capabilities.justification: `vault` commands read the owner-only 32-byte KEK and unseal the Chief vault (D18U).

capabilities.target: records under the configured vault storage root
capabilities.justification: `vault put` and `vault delete` write or remove sealed Chief secret records; the store is initialized on first use.
Authenticates and dispatches operator commands to the local WebSocket control API.

capabilities.target: absolute launchctl, systemctl, schtasks, and macOS id executables
capabilities.justification: Obtains the macOS user domain and registers the daemon through a native supervisor without a shell.
Prints generated help, version, deterministic daemon results, and stable failures.

capabilities.target: the secret value for `vault put`, bounded at 64 KiB
capabilities.justification: Secrets are read from stdin so they never appear in argv; an interactive terminal is refused rather than echoed (D18U U-C1, U-C2).
Stamps rotated_at_ms on each sealed secret record.

justification: Concrete local operator composition root; credentials and endpoints remain outside argv and all mutations use existing bounded adapters. Vault provisioning opens the sealed store locally with the owner-only KEK; the sealed store draws record keys and nonces from the OS CSPRNG.
